warnings: op1 direct read (house 13, Stage-2 SN-EE-M agent). Panel LP is single-phase, 10-way, 6 of 10 ways used: circuits 1-2 = lighting (confirmed on EE-03/EE-04 as '1/LP' ground-floor and '2/LP' upper-floor lighting home-run tags), 3-4 = outlets ('3/LP' ground floor on EE-05, '4/LP' upper floor on EE-06), 5-6 = water-heater junction boxes ('5/LP' ground floor on EE-05, '6/LP' upper floor on EE-06) -- i.e. each floor gets its own lighting/outlet/water-heater circuit, unlike house #10's smaller single-story 6-way panel which had only one of each. Circuits 7-10 spare.

element_type values 'circuit_breaker'/'electrical_service'/'grounding' are not in schema §0.4's core reuse list -- reused from houses 08/09's precedent (both already use this exact vocabulary for panel-schedule sheets) rather than inventing a third spelling, flagged per §0.4's instruction to note when a new-to-the-core-list value is introduced.

Main breaker 50AT,2P matches this house's larger 6-active-circuit load (vs house #10's 50AT single-story 3-circuit panel) despite the same main-breaker rating -- sized for the panel's 2-floor circuit count, not just present load.
